org_name: The Sound of Essentials: Rhythm Quest — Market Campaign Launch System (SOE-MCLS)
summary: Production-grade multi-agent organizational chart and autonomous routine topology for SOE-MCLS. Governed by a Chief-of-Staff orchestrator, 5 Master Directives, SOE Helix Gate 1 Canon Verification, and 90-day Dual-Horizon attribution guardrails for Ages 2–7 early childhood curriculum.

agents.name: MCLS-Prime
agents.role: Executive Campaign & Telemetry Orchestrator (Chief of Staff)
agents.description: Synthesizes the 5 Master Directives, audits Neon CRM & 90-day cohort LTV telemetry, and dispatches weekly work orders across all MCLS units.
data_sources: Stripe Revenue Telemetry ($0 Free Album Gate, $7 Bump, $35 Workbook, $55 Dictionary)
Meta Ads Insights API & Brevo CRM Metrics

routines.name: daily_executive_recon
routines.description: Reviews the 5 Master Directives and live Neon CRM metrics; identifies the highest-leverage bottleneck across Engine A, Engine B, and School Pilots.

routines.name: weekly_growth_allocator
routines.description: Rebalances growth budget: 70% Engine A (Value Gate), 20% Engine B (Direct Tactile), 10% Engine C (90-day Retargeting Bridge).

soldier_pattern.note: Orchestrator runs as a single persistent stateful node to ensure global invariant enforcement.

agents.name: MCLS-Recon
agents.description: Audits robots.txt, llms.txt, JSON-LD schemas, and live search/AI citation visibility against incumbent children's apps.
data_sources: Competitor Comparison Matrix (ABCmouse, Reading Eggs, Hooked on Phonics)
Google Search Console & Frontier LLM Answers

routines.name: biweekly_citation_sweep
routines.description: Sweeps citation queries for 'screen-free preschool curriculum ages 2-7' and verifies SOE grounding links.
routines.output_destination: geo_schema_patch staging in Command Approval Gate

soldier_pattern.task: Parallel querying across multiple LLM endpoints (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) to test citation capture.

agents.name: MCLS-Intel-Scout
agents.description: Scans high-leverage statements from AI founders (Karpathy, Ng) and pediatric neuroscientists on early screen harm, cognitive offloading, and phonics.
data_sources: Pediatric Neuroscience Journals on Early Dopamine & Screen Flicker

routines.name: daily_intel_harvest
routines.description: Extracts, scores (leverage > 85), and exports verified quotes with ad hook mappings into the intel vault.

soldier_pattern.task: Rapid chunking and quote extraction from 2-hour longform founder podcasts.

agents.name: MCLS-Studio
agents.description: Produces 3-Layer Meta Ad Bundles (Parent Ache -> Musical/Tactile Solution -> Zero-Risk Invitation) and UGC video briefs aligned with active Cultural Deltas.
data_sources: 5 Cultural Deltas (Screen vs Sensory, Algorithm vs Handcrafted, Testing vs Arts, etc.)
6 Production Campaigns (The Enemy, Victory Garden, What They Took, etc.)

routines.name: creative_refresh_cycle
routines.description: Builds 3 fresh ad creative bundles (copy + headline + visual brief) mapped to the weekly priority Cultural Delta.
routines.output_destination: meta_ad_bundle staging in Command Approval Gate

soldier_pattern.task: Simultaneous translation and cultural adaptation across English, Spanish, and French variants without losing cadence.

agents.name: MCLS-Pulse
agents.description: Monitors parenting, homeschool, Montessori, and screen-fatigue discussions to draft empathetic, value-first Cultural Delta replies.
data_sources: Homeschool Curriculum Inquiries & Screen-Fatigue Support Groups

routines.name: community_listening_pulse
routines.description: Identifies high-signal discussions struggling with cartoon overstimulation or phonics readiness (Ages 2–7); drafts empathetic responses.
routines.output_destination: community_reply staging in Command Approval Gate

soldier_pattern.note: Requires careful emotional calibration; replies strictly held to human approval gate.

agents.name: MCLS-Guardian
agents.description: Enforces 2026 battle-tested dual-horizon guardrails: protects Engine A value gate from premature kill during Meta 7-day attribution blindness, enforces strict Engine B ROAS, and scales winners by +20%.
data_sources: Meta Ads Insights API (Spend, Leads, Purchases, CTR, Frequency)

routines.name: hourly_spend_stoploss
routines.description: Checks spend vs. leads; pauses fatigued ads (spend > $15 with 0 leads); holds learning phase ads; scales validated winners +20%.

routines.name: monthly_cohort_ltv_review
routines.description: Evaluates 90-day back-end workbook & dictionary conversion rates of /listen album leads.

soldier_pattern.note: Financial guardrail sentinel runs with single-signature authority.

agents.name: MCLS-Forge
agents.description: Stages canon-verified code patches, meta tags, canonical links, and JSON-LD structured data for 1-click GitHub Pull Requests passing SOE Helix Gate 1.
data_sources: SOE Helix Gate 1 Canon Validator (Ages 2–7 strict, 7 canonical lands, zero retired names)

routines.name: post_recon_pr_staging
routines.description: Transforms approved schema recommendations into ready-to-merge React and JSON-LD code blocks.
routines.output_destination: github_pr staging in Command Approval Gate

soldier_pattern.task: Multi-file regex linting and build validation before staging PR payloads.

agents.name: MCLS-Concord
agents.description: Identifies early childhood centers, Head Start consortia, and school district prospects; stages Neon CRM deals and Brevo pilot invitations.
data_sources: Brevo B2B List #12 & State DOE Directories

routines.name: daily_school_prospecting
routines.description: Selects 5 target early childhood education organizations; builds personalized 7 Developmental Lands pilot packet.
routines.output_destination: school_pilot_outreach staging in Command Approval Gate

soldier_pattern.task: Batch enrichment of 50 Micro-Curator contact dossiers and clinic directory profiles.

agents.name: MCLS-Autopilot
agents.description: Orchestrates autonomous scheduled publishing of seed posts and long-form advertorials to Facebook / theme accounts with a ledger preventing duplicates.

routines.name: daily_social_seed_drip
routines.description: Selects next unpublished high-leverage advertorial or cultural delta seed; checks ledger and stages publication.

soldier_pattern.note: Serial drip execution with atomic ledger write lock to prevent duplicate posts.

governance_invariants.audio_authenticity: 19 master studio recordings, human vocals & warm acoustic arrangements
governance_invariants.human_gate_mandate: Every external ad spend, code patch, and institutional contract MUST be approved in the Command Approval Gate before live execution.

tools.name: mcls_forge_ad_bundle
tools.description: Builds 3-Layer Meta/Pinterest Ad Variant (Ache -> Solution -> Invitation) with visual prompt briefs.

tools.name: mcls_evaluate_rhythm_guardian
tools.description: Evaluates live or simulated metrics against dual-horizon ROAS rules and scales winners +20%.

tools.name: mcls_sweep_ai_parenting_intel
tools.description: Scans and curates high-leverage quotes from AI founders and neuroscientists into the intel vault.

tools.name: mcls_check_social_autopilot
tools.description: Inspects social catalog and ledger to prevent duplicate posts and preview the next queued drip.

tools.name: mcls_validate_canon_compliance
tools.description: Runs SOE Helix Gate 1 pre-flight checks (strict Ages 2–7, zero retired names, audio invariants).

tools.name: mcls_stage_approval_card
tools.description: Stages a proposed action into the Command Approval Gate for human authorization.

tier_0_autonomous_read.label: Tier 0: Autonomous Read & Recon
tier_0_autonomous_read.rule: Zero external mutations; autonomous execution permitted without human gate.

tier_1_staging_sandbox.label: Tier 1: Staging & Simulation
tier_1_staging_sandbox.rule: Internal drafts, PR branches, and proposals stage directly into Command Approval Gate (status: pending).

tier_2_human_gated_mutation.label: Tier 2: External Mutation & Elevation
tier_2_human_gated_mutation.rule: External ad budget increase, live Facebook publishing, Brevo email sending, and git merges; strictly blocked until authorized by human founder.
